Emily P: Quick kickoff — we need to align AWS/GCP/Azure catalog mapping + legal preflight for the cloud catalog. Target: staging listing by next Tue. Anyone blocked?
Raj K: Are we shipping bundles or single-SKU? I can map product tiers to SKUs if we decide bundles.
Emily P: Bundles for enterprise + SMB, single SKUs for trials. See sketch below.
Emily P: ```
bundle_enterprise -> [sku:RED-ENT-1, entitlements:dedicated, support:premium]
bundle_smb -> [sku:RED-SMB-1, entitlements:shared, support:standard]
trial -> [sku:RED-TRIAL-1, entitlements:trial-access]
```
Mike S: For AWS we need AMI IDs + region manifests. Can the packagers drop AMI placeholder in the manifest? Also confirm marketplace pricing tiers.
Sara L: Legal: need regional EULA + logos, trademark clearance. Also data residency note for EU customers. Share the EULA drafter by EOD.
marketplace-bot: checklist created: [catalog_manifest, logos, EULA, AMI_ids, pricing_table, trial_entitlements]
Emily P: @Sara L can you confirm whether the EULA template in /legal/templates/cloud-eula-v2 is OK for marketplaces? Link: https://redwood.internal/legal/cloud-eula-v2
Sara L: I will review. FYI if we include metering usage we'll need billing language updates.
Raj K: I'll produce SKU->product mapping spreadsheet and drop under /docs/marketplace/onboarding/sheets by Fri.
Mike S: I'll pull region AMI list & add a script snippet for manifest generation:
```bash
python tools/generate_manifest.py --amis amis.csv --output manifest.json
```
Emily P: Action items: Raj create spreadsheet; Mike add manifest script; Sara review EULA; I'll coordinate with partner ops for publisher account. Check-in Friday 11am PT. :thumbsup:
Raj K: 👍
Sara L: 👍
